About us

Useful updates, with the reasoning behind them.

Instant Virtuals Update shares virtual football information, selected betting-tip ideas and simple match analysis for people who enjoy following the game. Our aim is to make updates easy to find and selections easier to understand.

We encourage members to review every selection independently, set personal limits and never treat a tip as a guaranteed result.

Need to know

Frequently asked questions

A few quick answers before you join.

How do I join the Telegram channel?

Tap any “Join Telegram Group” button on this page. The invitation link will open Telegram, where you can preview and join the group.

What type of content is shared?

The community focuses on virtual football updates, betting-tip ideas, match analysis and related announcements.

Are the predictions guaranteed?

No. Football and virtual sports outcomes are uncertain. No prediction, tip or analysis can guarantee a win or profit.

Do I have to place bets to join?

No. Joining the Telegram community does not require you to place a bet. You can follow the information without wagering.

Can I use the website on my phone?

Yes. This landing page is responsive and designed to work on iPhones, Android phones, tablets and desktop browsers.
